changes.reason: The bounded single-variable test set holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0 -> 0.01 with terminal_tip_speed_weight left 0.0. At identical coverage the candidate worsened every physical metric rather than reducing holding-window speed: holding_max_speed_m_s +0.24238847269980157 (F389), holding_max_error_m +0.0053056960894252575 (F260), terminal_error_m +0.00046149168578060035 (F330), with classification physical_pareto_worsening (F630) and holding_speed_passed still false (F1017). The predicted holding-speed reduction did not appear, so this hypothesis is rejected for the tested value.

Baseline and candidate both report deadline_misses 35 (F158, F46) with delta 0 (F42); full warm plans and optimizer iteration traces (control_snapshots.json) remain not retained and no closed-loop counterfactual replay exists, so this competing hypothesis is untested and left unresolved; the unchanged deadline-miss count does not distinguish budget-limited from adequate-but-slow plans.

The candidate executed 35 control updates (F681) and is a valid complete execution (F664), but per-update plan-selection rows for the candidate are not displayed in this context and the historical full warm plans are not retained; no evidence here bears on whether initialization-heavy selection affected settling, so it remains unresolved.

Retained as excluded: deadline_misses are identical (delta 0, F42) across two configurations with different mean update times, and real_time_demonstrated is false in both (F945, F591); scheduling is synchronous, so wall overruns still provide no evidence of skipped simulated updates.

Retained as ruled out for both runs: terminal_reach_passed is true for candidate and baseline (F697, F294) and candidate terminal_error_m 0.008104100271647987 (F144) sits inside the 0.01 m tolerance; the failed condition remains confined to the sampled holding window.

The deferral precondition (no authorization and no complete-execution comparison) no longer holds: the bounded test was executed and refuted (physical_pareto_worsening F630; holding_speed_passed false F1017; holding_max_speed_m_s +0.24238847269980157 F389). Deferring further action on this specific value is not warranted.

Retained and strengthened: the 35 deadline misses persist identically in both configurations (F158, F46; delta 0, F42) while simulated outcomes differ, so the deadline misses are not attributable to skipped simulated updates or holding-window failure in either run.

Superseded: the decisive sealed complete comparison between two valid complete executions (F664, F540) with physical_pareto_worsening classification (F630) now exists, so continuing to defer all action pending further per-update rows is no longer the appropriate disposition even though the candidate per-update table is still not displayed.

new_facts.statement: Candidate improvement-7a36cd1a7c0d (holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0 -> 0.01, terminal_tip_speed_weight held at 0.0) versus baseline at identical coverage (35 control updates each, both valid_complete_execution true, F664/F540; terminal coverage 'last execution sample', F5/F193): candidate terminal_error_m 0.008104100271647987 (F144) vs baseline 0.007642608585867386 (F736), delta +0.00046149168578060035 m (F330); candidate holding_max_error_m 0.06344380037515782 (F505) vs 0.05813810428573256 (F364), delta +0.0053056960894252575 m (F260); candidate holding_max_speed_m_s 1.8234037466740822 (F619) vs 1.5810152739742807 (F214), delta +0.24238847269980157 m/s (F389). Classification physical_pareto_worsening (F630). Coverage: sealed comparison at matched coverage; componentwise physical comparison only.

Candidate acceptance flags: terminal_reach_passed true (F697, baseline F294); joint_reach_holding_passed false (F356, baseline F636); holding_position_passed false (F362); holding_speed_passed false (F1017); detail.sampled_settling.passed false (F270); sampled settling carries no continuous-time guarantee (F316, candidate F708). So the intended holding-speed target was not met by the candidate. Coverage: sealed campaign-comparison flags at matched coverage.

Computation outcome candidate vs baseline: candidate mean_complete_update_s 17.830149642877014 (F597) vs baseline 17.26331904856488 (F343), delta +0.5668305943121332 s (F265); deadline_misses 35 in both (F46, F158) with delta 0 (F42); solver_error_count 0 in both (F469, F426); real_time_demonstrated false in both (F945, F591); control_period_s 0.01 (F169) and control_updates 35 (F681) for the candidate. Coverage: sealed comparison scalars only, not per-update traces.

Both executions are valid complete executions (F664, F540) with force_bound_violation_n 0.0 (F904 baseline, F1025 candidate); coverage is 'last execution sample' for terminal (F193, F5) and 'all retained samples in final 0.05 s' for holding (F574, F897). Comparison is derived arithmetic from sealed complete evaluations and profile (F850), and the ranking rule states joint acceptance first, otherwise componentwise physical comparison (F98), with raw scalar objectives under different weights not ranked (F585). Citations and source agreement do not establish causality.

new_limitations: The sealed candidate comparison is one execution per configuration at seed 17; it fixes the measured outcome at matched coverage but does not identify a causal mechanism, and in particular does not explain the wrong-sign (worsening) holding-speed change under the positive weight.

Sampled settling carries no continuous-time guarantee (F316, F708); reported holding values cover the retained sample set (all retained samples in the final 0.05 s, F574/F897) rather than the whole trajectory.

Per-update computation rows and per-sample holding-window rows for the candidate are still not displayed in this context; full warm plans and optimizer iteration traces (control_snapshots.json) remain not retained, and no closed-loop counterfactual replay tool exists.
Raw scalar objectives under different weights are not ranked (F585); only componentwise physical metrics are compared (F98).
arguments.rationale: Candidate-minus-baseline outcomes, reported separately at identical coverage (35 control updates each; both valid_complete_execution true, F664/F540; terminal coverage 'last execution sample', F5/F193): Reach - both pass (F697/F294); candidate terminal_error_m 0.008104100271647987 (F144) vs baseline 0.007642608585867386 (F736), delta +0.00046149168578060035 m (F330), i.e. a small reach-margin worsening that remains inside tolerance. Holding position - worsened: candidate holding_max_error_m 0.06344380037515782 (F505) vs 0.05813810428573256 (F364), delta +0.0053056960894252575 m (F260); holding_position_passed false (F362). Holding speed - the intended target worsened rather than improved: candidate holding_max_speed_m_s 1.8234037466740822 (F619) vs 1.5810152739742807 (F214), delta +0.24238847269980157 m/s (F389); holding_speed_passed false (F1017). Computation - slower: candidate mean_complete_update_s 17.830149642877014 (F597) vs 17.26331904856488 (F343), delta +0.5668305943121332 s (F265); deadline_misses unchanged at 35 each (F46/F158, delta F42); solver_error_count 0 both (F469/F426); real_time_demonstrated false both (F945/F591). Overall classification physical_pareto_worsening (F630). These are derived arithmetic from sealed complete evaluations/profile (F850); the arithmetic and source agreement do not certify a causal mechanism, and the ranking rule compares physical metrics componentwise (F98) rather than raw weighted objectives (F585).
arguments.recommendation: Diagnostic side (separate from controller selection): accept and retain rec-defer-no-wall-overrun-causal-claim (deadline-miss delta 0, F42); reject rec-defer-tip-speed-weight-hypothesis for the tested value 0.01 and reject rec-defer-until-per-update-and-per-sample-rows-read as superseded by the sealed complete comparison; keep the solver-budget/stop-status and initialization-heavy-selection hypotheses unresolved. Controller side: do not adopt candidate improvement-7a36cd1a7c0d; retain baseline configuration af649bf56cf8642bb85090227ec5390398aff23a96686f972933e24715ba8fd0, and treat sampled holding position and speed as still unmet (candidate joint_reach_holding_passed false, F356; holding_speed_passed false, F1017).
